name: Miracle Workers
description: An anthology series in which a colorful blend of outcasts and iconoclasts confront universal issues across various time periods: love, faith, societal norms, and venturing into the unknown.

videos.title: 2 Weeks
videos.overview: Frustrated with the mess that earth's become, God contemplates the end while two determined angels try to change his mind.

videos.title: 13 Days
videos.overview: God asks Sanjay to smite a non-believer, while Craig and Eliza realize they have their work cut out for them.

videos.title: 12 Days
videos.overview: A troublesome human complicates Craig and Eliza's plan, while Sanjay attempts to burnish his credentials.

videos.title: 6 Days
videos.overview: Craig helps God recruit a prophet while Sanjay heads to the basement to help save Earth.

videos.title: 3 Days
videos.overview: Rosie meets with a competitor while Craig, Eliza, and Sanjay try to dupe God.

videos.title: 1 Day
videos.overview: God meets with potential investors for his groundbreaking new restaurant.

videos.title: 1 Hour
videos.overview: Craig risks it all in a desperate attempt to save Earth and all of mankind.

videos.title: Graduation
videos.overview: Allie pursues her education, such as it is and finds her place in the family business. Prince Chauncley tries to live up to his father's expectations, but King Cragnoor sets a very high bar. Eddie almost loses his head, quite literally.

videos.title: Help Wanted
videos.overview: Alexandra is excited when she's offered a job by the town's doctor, but soon realizes she is facing a moral dilemma. Prince Chauncley loses one of his favorite ducks.

videos.title: Road Trip
videos.overview: Prince Chauncley and Lord Vexler go on a diplomatic mission. A new invention shakes up Eddie's business.

videos.title: Internship
videos.overview: Prince Chauncley gets an internship and Mikey makes some new friends.

videos.title: Holiday
videos.overview: Al and Prince Chauncley struggle to deal with their families over the holidays.

videos.title: Music Festival
videos.overview: Al and Maggie go to a music festival. Prince Chauncley deals with a temperamental rock star.

videos.title: Day in Court
videos.overview: Al sues the crown. Prince Chauncley makes an unexpected breakthrough with his father.

videos.title: First Date
videos.overview: Al and Prince Chauncley attend an astronomy lecture and Eddie meets a new neighbor.

videos.title: Moving Out (1)
videos.overview: Al and Prince Chauncley make big plans for their futures.

videos.title: Moving Out (2)
videos.overview: Al and Prince Chauncley face their biggest challenge yet.

videos.title: Hittin' the Trail
videos.overview: Small-town reverend Ezekiel Brown enlists outlaw Benny the Teen to lead his people west along the Oregon Trail. Repressed prairie wife Prudence Aberdeen responds to the freedom of the trail, pulling her away from her wealthy husband Todd.

videos.title: Fording the River
videos.overview: The wagon train must ford a dangerous river, leading to a moral struggle between Ezekiel and Benny over the soul of the group. Meanwhile, Prudence and Todd meet hipster pioneers living #wagonlife.

videos.title: Hunting Party
videos.overview: Ezekiel signs up for a buffalo hunting expedition to prove his manhood. Meanwhile, Benny teaches Prudence how to be a bandit.

videos.title: What Happens in Branchwater
videos.overview: The wagon train stops in the sinful town of Branchwater, luring Ezekiel into a night of debauchery and temptation. Meanwhile, Benny finds his favourite saloon has transformed into an inauthentic tourist trap.

videos.title: Meet the Noonans
videos.overview: The wagon train meets a religious group being led West by a holy prophet. Meanwhile, Benny tries to reconnect with his estranged daughter.

videos.title: Independence Rock
videos.overview: The wagon train stops at Independence Rock to celebrate the Fourth of July. While Ezekiel and Prudence try to enjoy the holiday, Benny attempts to reclaim his place as the number one outlaw in the west.

videos.title: White Savior
videos.overview: Benny tries to become a hero to a Native American tribe.

videos.title: Over the Mountain
videos.overview: The wagon train attempts to cross the Blue Mountains, but Ezekiel worries their journey has been cursed by God. Meanwhile, Benny tries to make amends with Trig.

videos.title: Stranded
videos.overview: Ezekiel, Benny, and the farmers face starvation as they try to survive a blizzard. Meanwhile, Todd gets into politics.

videos.title: End of the Trail
videos.overview: The wagon train faces its final showdown.

videos.title: Welcome to Boomtown
videos.overview: Lone wanderer Sid and warlord Freya struggle to adjust after moving from the apocalyptic wasteland to the suburbs.

videos.title: H.O.A.
videos.overview: Freya runs for president of the Boomtown Homeowners Association. Morris takes Sid on a perilous business trip.

videos.title: The MatriXXX
videos.overview: Sid and Freya try to improve their sex life with couple's therapy. Morris attends his high school reunion.

videos.title: The Grouping Ceremony
videos.overview: Sid tries to help Morris get his son into a prestigious school. Freya attempts to prove she’s not too old to party.

videos.title: Jim Carrey in the Park
videos.overview: Morris puts on a theatrical production of Ace Ventura: Pet Detective. Sid goes on a weekend trip with Tai and his friends.

videos.title: Olympus
videos.overview: Sid and Freya visit Freya’s parents. Morris and Tai share an intimate evening together.

videos.title: Roland Proudheart
videos.overview: Sid buys a flashy new vehicle called a “Bifi” and it starts to become his whole personality. Scraps returns to his old village.

videos.title: Children of Women
videos.overview: Sid and Freya find out Freya is pregnant, and Morris throws them a baby shower. Tai has to pet-sit Scraps while going back in time to terminate the future leader of the human resistance.

videos.title: John Christ
videos.overview: Freya reunites with her old gang of war dogs. Sid joins an anti-robot extremist group. Tai enters a talent competition to prove he’s not obsolete.

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: The final battle for Boomtown.
